quotes/barclay-silent-worship-para/text: Barclay taught that true worship is not tied to set times, places or forms, but consists in the inward stirring of God’s Spirit; Friends therefore gather in silence, waiting upon the Lord, and speak, pray or sing only when moved by the Spirit.
quotes/finney-revival-not-miracle/text: A revival is not a miracle, or dependent on a miracle, in any sense. It is a purely philosophical result of the right use of the constituted means.
quotes/nevin-anxious-bench-para/text: Nevin contrasted the "system of the bench", which relies on excitement and sudden decisions, with the "system of the catechism", in which the church nurtures faith through preaching, sacraments and patient instruction; he judged the new measures a shallow, man-centred substitute.
quotes/sacrosanctum-concilium-participat: The Council desired that all the faithful be led to the "full, conscious, and active participation" in liturgical celebrations that the nature of the liturgy demands and that is their right and duty by baptism; the liturgy is the summit toward which the Church’s activity is directed and the fount from which its power flows.
quotes/traditionis-custodes-para/text: Francis decreed that the liturgical books promulgated by Paul VI and John Paul II in conformity with Vatican II are the unique expression of the lex orandi of the Roman Rite, and explained that use of the older Missal had come to be exploited to reject the Council and divide the Church.
quotes/benedict-two-forms-para/text: Benedict XVI argued that the 1962 and 1970 Missals are two usages of the one Roman Rite, and that what earlier generations held as sacred remains sacred and great for us too and cannot suddenly be entirely forbidden or harmful.
quotes/campbell-instruments-para/text: Alexander Campbell wrote that to all spiritually minded Christians instrumental music in worship would be as unwelcome as a cow bell in a concert, a carnal aid to those who lacked a spiritual mind.
